title: rag.py eval hides a real pack note when a drifted row's re-judged pack also carries one
goal: rag.py eval's NOTED_BASELINE comparison counts every row whose pack carries a check: or route: line, a drifted row included: a row that is both drifted and noted is no longer counted once in noted and subtracted once as drifted (rag.py `over = res['noted'] - res['drifted'] > NOTED_BASELINE`), and the live-kb eval test makes the same count; found by the SP-z3jcdsgr review (S3).

run: import sys;s=open('_tools/rag.py',encoding='utf-8').read();sys.exit(1 if "res['noted'] - res['drifted']" in s or 'res["noted"] - res["drifted"]' in s else 0)

repro_reason: The defect needs a live kb state where a drifted row's re-judged pack also carries a check: or route: line; main holds none (14 noted, 1 drifted, 13 real notes), so the repro reads the comparison rag.py makes.
